detail: The plugin pin bump is V6, explicitly gated to one release after stable. And re-running migrate under the beta would stamp version: 2 into config.yml, which would turn the plugin's 1.24 server (also active in this repo) read-only and break its hook enforcement mid-soak. The beta server writes version-1 sqlite state fine, so the pin switch alone gives the soak signal without degrading the session tooling.
summary: Dogfood the v2 beta via the project .mcp.json pin (twining-mcp@next), NOT the plugin pin and NOT a version-2 config stamp yet
